17:1: Exalted is that Allah who walked His servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We made blessed, that We might show him of Our signs He walked [him]. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
17:2: We gave Moses the Book and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel: Do not take any trustee besides Me.
17:3: O descendants of those whom We carried with Noah, indeed he was a servant who was very grateful.
17:4: And We decreed to the Children of Israel in the Book: You will cause corruption on the earth twice and you will exalt yourselves with great arrogance.
17:5: When the promise of the first of the two came, We sent upon you servants of Ours of great might, and they entered between the dwellings.
17:6: Then We gave you back supremacy over them, and supported you with wealth and sons, and made you more numerous in number.
17:7: If you do good, you have done good to yourselves, and if you do evil, it is to yourselves. When the subsequent promise came, let them deface your faces, enter the masjid as they entered it the first time, and utterly destroy whatever they conquered.
17:8: It may be that your Rabb will have mercy on you. If you return, We will return. We have made Hell a prison for the disbelievers.
17:9: Indeed, this Quran guides to that which is most upright, and gives glad tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that for them is a great reward.
17:10: And for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have prepared a painful punishment.
17:11: Man prays for evil to come just as he prays for good to come in his prayer, and man is hasty.
17:12: We made the night and the day two signs. We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day illuminating, so that you may seek bounty from your Rabb and know the number of years and the count. And We have explained everything in detail.
17:13: We have fastened every human's deed to his neck, and on the Day of Resurrection We will bring forth for him a book which he will encounter wide open.
17:14: Read your book; today your own soul is sufficient as a reckoner against you.
17:15: Whoever is guided is only guided for his own soul, and whoever strays only strays against it, and no bearer of burdens bears the burden of another.
17:16: When We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent ones, and they commit wickedness therein. Thus the word becomes justified against that city, and We destroy it completely.
17:17: How many generations We destroyed after Noah! And of the sins of His servants, your Rabb is Aware and Seeing.
17:18: Whoever desires the transient, We hasten therein what We will to whom We will. Then We appoint Hell for him; he enters it condemned and banished.
17:19: And whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it while being a believer, it is those whose striving is worthy of gratitude.
17:20: To all—both these and those—We extend from the bounty of your Rabb, and the bounty of your Rabb is not restricted.
17:21: Look how We favored some of them over others. Surely the Hereafter is greater in degrees and greater in preference.
17:22: Do not set up another deity with Allah, or you will sit condemned and forsaken.
17:23: Your Rabb has decreed that you worship none but Him and do good to parents. If one of them or both of them reach old age beside you, do not even say "uff" to them and do not rebuke them, and speak to them a noble word.
17:24: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy, and say: "My Rabb, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small."
17:25: Your Rabb knows best what is in your souls. If you are righteous, indeed He is Most Forgiving to those who frequently turn [to Him].
17:26: And give the relative his right, and the needy, and the traveler, and do not squander wastefully.
17:27: Indeed, the squanderers have become brothers of the devils, and Satan has been very ungrateful to his Rabb.
17:28: And if you turn away from them seeking a mercy you hope for from your Rabb, speak to them a gentle word.
17:29: Do not make your hand tied to your neck, nor open it completely, or you will sit blamed and remorseful.
17:30: Indeed, your Rabb expands provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed, He is Aware of His servants, Seeing.
17:31: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, killing them is a great error.
17:32: Do not approach zina; indeed, it was an indecency and an evil way.
17:33: Do not kill the soul that Allah has forbidden except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly, We have given his guardian an authority; so let him not exceed limits in killing, for he has been helped.
17:34: Do not approach the property of the orphan except by what is best until he reaches maturity, and fulfill the covenant, for the covenant will be questioned.
17:35: When you measure, make the measure full and weigh with a straight scale. This is better and fairer in end result.
17:36: Do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, hearing, sight, and heart—all of these will be questioned about it.
17:37: Do not walk on the earth boastfully, for you can never tear the earth apart and you can never reach the mountains in height.
17:38: The evil of all of these is disliked in the sight of your Rabb.
17:39: This is of the wisdom that your Rabb has revealed to you. Do not set up another deity along with Allah, or you will be thrown, condemned and banished.
17:40: Did your Rabb choose you with sons and take females from the angels? Indeed, you are saying a grave word.
17:41: And We have certainly explained in varied ways in this Quran so that they may reflect, but it only increases them in aversion.
17:42: Say: If there had been deities along with Him, as they say, then they would have sought a way to the Owner of the Throne.
17:43: He is Exalted, and high above what they say, with great sublimity.
17:44: The seven heavens, the earth, and whoever is in them glorify Him. There is nothing that does not glorify Him with praise. But you do not understand their glorification. Indeed, He is Halim, Most Forgiving.
17:45: When you recite the Quran, We place a hidden veil between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter.
17:46: We placed coverings over their hearts preventing them from understanding it, and a heaviness in their ears. When you mention your Rabb alone in the Quran, they turn their backs and flee.
17:47: We know best what they listen to when they listen to you, and when they converse privately, the wrongdoers say, "You are only following a bewitched man."
17:48: Look how they struck similitudes for you and so went astray; now they cannot find a way.
17:49: They said: When we are bones and crumbled dust, will we really be resurrected in a new creation?
17:50: Say: Be you stones or iron.
17:51: Or become a creation that grows in your breasts. They will say: 'Who will bring us back?' Say: 'He who created you the first time.' They will shake their heads at you and say, 'When will it be?' Say: 'It may be that it is near.'
17:52: On the day He calls you, you will respond praising Him, and you will think that you stayed only a little while.
17:53: Say to My servants that they should say that which is best, for Satan sows discord between them. Indeed, Satan is an open enemy to man.
17:54: Your Rabb knows you better. If He wills, He will have mercy on you, or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you as a guardian over them.
17:55: Your Rabb knows better whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And certainly We favored some of the prophets over others, and We gave David the Zabur.
17:56: Say: 'Call upon those whom you claimed besides Him; they have no power to remove harm from you, nor to change it.'
17:57: Those whom they call upon seek a means of access to their Rabb, as to which of them is nearer. They hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Rabb is a thing to be guarded against.
17:58: There is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. This is written in the Book.
17:59: Nothing prevented Us from sending the signs except that the earlier people denied them. And We gave Thamud the female camel as a clear sign, but they wronged her.
17:60: And when We said to you that indeed your Rabb has encompassed the people. And We made the vision which We showed you and the tree cursed in the Quran only as a trial for the people. We warn them, but this increases them in nothing except great transgression.
17:61: And when We said to the angels, 'Prostrate to Adam,' and they prostrated, except Iblis. He said: 'Shall I prostrate to one whom You created from clay?'
17:62: He said: 'Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You grant me respite until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely bring his descendants under my control, except a few.'
17:63: He said: 'Go! Whoever of them follows you, indeed, Hell is your recompense, an ample recompense.'
17:64: And incite with your voice whichever of them you can, and assault them with your cavalry and your infantry, and be a partner with them in wealth and children, and make promises to them. Yet Satan promises them nothing but deceit.
17:65: Indeed, over My servants there is no authority for you, and your Rabb is sufficient as a guardian.
17:66: Your Rabb is the One who makes ships sail upon the sea for you so that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is most merciful toward you.
17:67: When harm touches you at sea, those you call upon besides Him vanish; then when He saves you and brings you to land, you turn away. And man is ever ungrateful.
17:68: Or do you feel secure that He will not cause a side of the land to swallow you up, or send a sandstorm against you? Then you would not find for yourselves a guardian.
17:69: Or do you feel secure that He will not return you to it another time, then send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you because of your ingratitude? Then you would not find for yourselves any helper against Us concerning it.
17:70: And certainly We have honored the children of Adam, and We carried them on land and sea, and We provided them with good things, and We favored them over many of those We have created.
17:71: On that Day We will call every community of people with their leader. Those who are given their book in their right hand, it is they who will read their book and will not be wronged by as much as a thread.
17:72: Whoever is blind in this world, he will be blind in the Hereafter and even further astray from the path.
17:73: They almost tempted you to fabricate against Us something other than what We revealed to you; in that case they would have taken you as an intimate friend.
17:74: And if We had not made you stand firm, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
17:75: Then We would have made you taste a double portion of life and a double portion of death, then you would not have found for yourself a helper against Us.
17:76: They almost unsettled you from the land to drive you out of it. In that case, after you, they would have stayed there only a little while.
17:77: This is the sunnah of Our messengers whom We sent before you, and you will not find any change in Our sunnah.
17:78: Establish the prayer from the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night, and the Quran of the dawn. Indeed, the Quran of the dawn is witnessed.
17:79: And during a part of the night pray tahajjud with it as an additional act of worship for you; it may be that your Rabb will raise you to a praised station.
17:80: And say: 'My Rabb, cause me to enter with an entrance of truthfulness and cause me to exit with an exit of truthfulness, and grant me from Yourself a helping authority.'
17:81: Say: 'Truth has come, and falsehood has vanished. Indeed, falsehood is bound to vanish.'
17:82: And We send down from the Quran that which is healing and mercy for the believers, and it increases the wrongdoers in nothing but loss.
17:83: When We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and draws aside. And when evil touches him, he becomes hopeless.
17:84: Say: 'Everyone acts according to his own disposition. Your Rabb knows best who is more guided in way.'
17:85: They ask you about the spirit. Say: 'The spirit is by the command of my Rabb, and you have been given of knowledge but a little.'
17:86: And if We willed, We could surely take away that which We have revealed to you; then you would not find for yourself against Us a guardian concerning it.
17:87: Except as a mercy from your Rabb. Indeed, His bounty upon you is great.
17:88: Say: 'By oath, if mankind and the jinn gathered to bring the like of this Quran, they could not bring the like of it, even if they were helpers to one another.'
17:89: And certainly, We have varied and explained every kind of example for the people in this Quran, yet most of the people refused everything except disbelief.
17:90: They said: 'We will never believe in you until you make a spring gush forth for us from the earth.'
17:91: Or you have a garden of date palms and grapes, and you make rivers gush forth through them.
17:92: Or you cause the heaven to fall upon us in pieces as you claimed, or you bring Allah and the angels face to face.
17:93: Or you have a house of gold, or you ascend into the sky, and we will never believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book that we may read.
17:94: What prevented people from believing when guidance came to them was only that they said: 'Has Allah sent a human being as a messenger?'
17:95: Say: 'If there were angels walking on the earth settled, We would surely have sent down to them an angel messenger from heaven.'
17:96: Say: 'Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you. Indeed, He is Aware of His servants, Seeing.'
17:97: Whomever Allah guides, that one has found guidance. And whomever He leads astray, you can no longer find friends for them besides Him. And We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection upon their faces, blind, mute, and deaf. Their refuge is Hell. Whenever it begins to subside, We increase the flame for them.
17:98: That is their recompense, because they denied Our verses and said: 'When we have become bones and crumbled dust, will we really be resurrected in a new creation?'
17:99: Did they not see that Allah, who created the heavens and the earth, is capable of creating the like of them? He appointed a term for them in which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers only rejected disbelief.
17:100: Say: 'If you possessed the treasures of the mercy of my Rabb, you would then hold back for fear of spending, and man is very stingy.'
17:101: And by oath, We gave Moses nine clear signs. Ask the Children of Israel; when he came to them, Pharaoh said to him: 'O Moses, surely I think you are bewitched.'
17:102: He said: 'By oath, you knew that none but the Rabb of the heavens and the earth sent these down as clear evidences. And I certainly think you, O Pharaoh, are ruined.'
17:103: Thereupon Pharaoh wanted to drive them out from the land, so We drowned him and all those who were with him.
17:104: And after him We said to the Children of Israel: 'Dwell in the land. When the promise of the Hereafter comes, We will bring you as a mixed crowd.'
17:105: And with truth We sent it down, and with truth it came down, and We sent you only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
17:106: And We divided the Quran so that you may recite it to the people with a pause, and We sent it down progressively.
17:107: Say: 'Believe in it or do not believe.' Surely those who were given knowledge before it, when it is recited to them, prostrate upon their chins.
17:108: And they say: 'Our Rabb is glorified. Surely the promise of our Rabb will be fulfilled.'
17:109: And they fall upon their chins, they weep, and it increases their humility.
17:110: Say: "Call upon Allah or call upon ar-Rahman. Whichever you call upon, the most beautiful names belong to Him." Do not raise your voice in your salah, and do not conceal it, and seek a way between the two.
17:111: And say: 'Praise is to Allah, who has not taken a child, who has no partner in dominion, and who has no need of a helper due to humiliation.' And magnify Him with takbir.
